question: What was settled revenue in H1 2026?

input.sql: SELECT SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS settled_revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'settled' AND p.payment_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND p.payment_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
